marco (partnerships): Sync reminder 00: vendor call at 11am PT. Need alignment on SI handoffs and marketplace gating for Gaudi and MI300 images. Also open question: do we mark Gaudi as GA on marketplace when MI300 still in preview?

nina (solutions): For SI handoffs we need image parity and a how-to doc. If Gaudi GA differs in driver/BIOS, that will confuse integrators. Recommend single source-of-truth docs in marketplace listing notes.

raj (hw-ops): Gaudi GA OK, but note perf difference vs MI300 on some kernels. Uploading per-kernel diffs.

kevin (sales): Sales note: partner customers ask for clear SLA language per SKU. If we delay MI300 announcement, make sure sales decks reflect current availability.

ana (marketing): ana (marketing): We'll keep marketplace GA per-SKU based on vendor readiness. Drafting comms now.

marco (partnerships): Action: raj to upload kernel diffs. nina to draft SI handoff doc. ana to align marketplace descriptions. Invite posted.

deploy-bot: Invite created - "gaudi-mi300-marketplace-handoff" - 2026-03-25 11:00 PT.
